content_blocks.label: clause_1._Notice_Period
content_blocks.text: ALEXANDER THOMPSON is hereby given notice that his tenancy at 123 Maple Street, Brookside City, will terminate on November 15, 2024.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Cause_for_Eviction
content_blocks.text: The cause for the termination of this tenancy is non-payment of rent as required under the lease agreement.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Removal_of_Personal_Property
content_blocks.text: ALEXANDER THOMPSON shall remove all personal property from the premises within thirty (30) days of receipt of this notice.
